rubrics.justification: Describes a Day 5 expanded/full blastocyst consistent with 3AB, with strong ICM and somewhat weaker TE, and notes intact zona and lack of gross degeneration. Minor uncertainty/fabrication remains because some image-specific details are inferred from a single static image.

Integrates age, tubal factor, ovarian response, sperm parameters, BMI, prior IVF failures, biochemical pregnancy, and endometrial thickness well, and connects these factors to prognosis and embryo quality.

Overall logic is clear and internally consistent, with probability estimate tied to favorable age/morphology and tempered by prior failures and 7 mm lining. Minor issues include speculative comments about only one embryo and recurrent loss risk.

Recommendations are largely consistent with IVF practice: SET at age 29, caution about morphology vs ploidy, selective rather than routine PGT-A, uterine reassessment after repeated failures, and avoidance of low-evidence add-ons. Slight overreach in some speculative workup suggestions.

Provides clear next steps for current transfer and future planning, including SET, luteal support optimization, uterine cavity reassessment, consideration of chronic endometritis/RPL-style workup if failures continue, and review of transfer technique.
